name: The Obstacle Table (d20)
description:
The quiet way gets past without a fuss; the loud way works too, but Suspicion rises by 1 whatever the result (Chapter 5). At a group obstacle, everyone there rolls for themselves (Chapter 4).

Rulebook, Chapter 8: The Obstacle Table.
